Ava (CSM): Heads-up — NovaHealth QBR prep. Need a concise burn table + 2 commit options and a short enablement checklist by EOD. Key asks: peak day, monthly median, soft/hard alert levels. @Diego @Priya @Liam

Diego (FinOps): Uploading 90d CSV. Using current encoder estimate = 410 tok/call. Will produce A (conservative) and B (buffered) numbers.

Diego (FinOps): Quick table (draft):
Scenario A: median_monthly=4,800,000 | peak_day=240,000 | soft=180,000 | hard=288,000
Scenario B: median_monthly=6,000,000 | peak_day=300,000 | soft=225,000 | hard=360,000
One-line rec: Commit to Scenario A + enable alerts at Scenario A soft threshold; offer 1-month trial at B.

Priya (CS Ops): Enablement checklist: 30m workshop, 1-pager cost knobs, post-survey (5 q), collect 3 prompts. I can own artifacts and invites.

Liam (Solutions Eng): Ops guardrail snippet: if rolling7d_avg>soft: drop batch_size 20%; if today>hard: enable hard throttle + fallback model. Add runbook links.

OnboardingBot: Notice: novaw crossed soft threshold earlier this week (auto-soft applied). Incident #INC-2025-4201.

Ava (CSM): Great — Diego finalize numbers + CSV link, Priya upload materials by 3pm PT, Liam add runbook links. Renewal risk: MEDIUM. Dry run tomorrow 9:30am PT. :white_check_mark:
